entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: Welcome, sir. Have you already had[n]your meal?

entries.en: I have.

entries.en: Why do you ask?

entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: In that case, why not make use of the[n]exclusive member's restaurant up ahead?

entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: The best dishes prepared by our most[n]expert chefs are served there.

entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: Is that so? Then please enjoy the rest[n]of your time here.

entries.speaker: Bartender

entries.speaker: Bartender

entries.en: Has anyone turned anything in?

entries.en: I'd like a drink.

entries.en: I have no business here now.

entries.speaker: Bartender

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shoot, this isn't good! Let's get out of[n]here, Joker!

entries.speaker: Bartender
